_why: local-guides-citation-velocity names its verticals one way and this repo's
generator names its page-set folders another way. Each side kept its own list
and nothing linked them, so generate_from_candidates.js silently skipped every
candidate whose upstream name it did not recognise:
'personal_injury' and 'uscis' were emitted by velocity and known to nobody here.
All 9 candidates this repo had never ingested were personal_injury, so the
seam produced 0 guides even once source resolution was repaired.
This file is the single link between the two lists. Both the generator and the
seam validator read it, so adding a vertical upstream fails loudly here instead
of being dropped on the floor.
